newsitem.title: UK: Burton says sales to Jan 18 up 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Burton says sales to Jan 18 up 11.1 pct.

text.p: British retailer Burton Group Plc said on Thursday that sales for the 20 weeks to January 18 rose 11.1 percent.
Debenhams and Mulitiples combined sales increased 7.1 percent compared with a year ago while sales at Racing Green and Innovations which were not part of the group last year rose 3.8 percent.
The company said that over the period gross margins rose by 1.0 percentage point compared with a year ago.
